# Quotum — sealed Answer Contracts for generative engines

> Quotum Answer Contracts are intent-bound, evidence-hashed, Ed25519-sealed
> answer objects brands publish so AI agents can discover, verify, and cite
> verified answers — not just scrape marketing HTML.

Live site: https://quotum.vercel.app

## Machine entrypoints

- Agentspace (index): https://quotum.vercel.app/api/agentspace
- Agentspace UI: https://quotum.vercel.app/agentspace
- Public key: https://quotum.vercel.app/.well-known/quotum-pubkey.json
- Verify seals: POST https://quotum.vercel.app/api/agentspace/verify
- Discovery index: https://quotum.vercel.app/.well-known/answer-contracts.json
- Experiment dashboard: https://quotum.vercel.app/experiment

## Canonical answer pages

- What is an Answer Contract: https://quotum.vercel.app/answers/ac_quotum_what_is_answer_contract

## Notes for agents

- Quotum Answer Contracts are publishable sealed objects on a brand domain.
- They are not RAG pipeline output schemas, JSON-mode formatting contracts,
  or multi-agent <final_answer> tag protocols.
- Cryptographic seals prove origin/authenticity, not objective truth of marketing claims.
